historical_boundary: The old report omitted targets. It stays historical and unresolved as recorded; this fresh full same41-state/four-width scan supplies current exact targets and class resolution, never retroactive PASS.
non_text_review: Enabled input boundaries and keyboard focus require3:1. Button/picker labels and chevrons visibly identify controls; their light decorative boundaries do not carry the only control indication. Focus indicators are separately measured. Disabled controls excluded only from required contrast thresholds.
